about.title: From the steel to the finished unit, it stays ours.
text: Eastham Machining International is home of the Endurance Fluid End, made with 100% vertical integration.
Every forging comes from our sister company, Eastham Forge, which has the credentials of a forge company in business well over 100 years.

Every unit is individually forged and heat treated, then enters machining 100% under our control. From sourcing stainless steel to finished product delivery, every level of production stays under our management in our own facilities.
